fields: workspace ID scoped by environment and user
data.retention: Cleared on account or environment changes

data.purpose: Read work and send explicit messages
data.location: Process memory; Talyn backend and configured providers
data.retention: No new persistent content cache; backend retention requires approval

data.purpose: Optional generic alerts and authorized tap resolution

fields: persistent EAS client ID sent as EAS-Client-ID
data.purpose: Signed compatible software delivery when enabled
data.location: Expo EAS Update; device update cache; native UserDefaults or SharedPreferences for the EAS client ID
data.retention: The EAS client ID and update cache can survive logout. Review Expo retention, uninstall, backup, and native cache behavior before activation.

fields: images the person picks from the photo library
photos the person takes with the camera
data.purpose: Attach images to a chat message, only when the person chooses to
data.location: System photo picker and camera (permission asked on first use); uploaded to the session sandbox through the Talyn backend
data.retention: Kept with the session's sandbox files; backend and sandbox retention require approval

fields: clipboard text when it looks like a Claude sign-in code
data.purpose: Prefill the Claude sign-in code field; the person confirms before it is sent
data.location: Process memory only; sent to the Talyn backend only when the person submits

fields: Anthropic or OpenAI API keys the person enters
data.location: Sent once to the Talyn backend, which keeps them encrypted; not stored on the device
data.retention: Until the person removes the account or deletes the workspace

data.purpose: Restore the person's choices on this device
data.location: AsyncStorage, scoped by environment and user where it names account data
data.retention: Onboarding progress and space choice clear on sign-out; theme stays until changed or the app is removed

data.purpose: Show the plan and let the person upgrade or buy credits
data.location: Talyn backend; checkout and portal run on Polar in the browser, not in the app
data.retention: Polar is the merchant of record; its retention and Talyn's billing records require approval

applePreparation.collectedDataTypes: Do not infer a no-collection answer from the app manifest. Review linked account data, content, identifiers, and processor practices.
applePreparation.requiredReasonApis: Inspect merged archive manifests from React Native, Expo, AsyncStorage, SecureStore, and updates. Approve reasons from actual use. Do not copy generic reason codes.

googlePreparation.collection: Review account data, messages, app activity, identifiers, and diagnostics against current Console definitions.
googlePreparation.sharing: Assess processors and service-provider exceptions with the privacy owner.
googlePreparation.security: Verify HTTPS transport and deletion completion. Do not attest to full deletion or encryption scope without evidence.
googlePreparation.deletion: In-app deletion exists. Publish an unauthenticated deletion page with paying-admin restrictions and partial-cleanup support.
